deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.
deletion_policy.rationale: Controls how the resource gets removed. Allowing ABANDON leaves it orphaned outside Terraform, so this is worth enforcing, so true.

description.description: An optional description of this resize-request.
description.rationale: Just a free text description. It doesn't affect how the resource works or its security, so false.

instance_group_manager.description: The reference of the instance group manager this ResizeRequest is a part of.
instance_group_manager.rationale: This points to the instance group manager this request belongs to. It's a reference to another resource, not a security control, so false.

name.description: The name of this resize request. The name must be 1-63 characters long, and comply with RFC1035.
name.rationale: The name is just an identifier for the resource, not something you put a security rule on, so this is false.

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: Project just says where the resource lives, it's not a security control on the resource itself, so false.

resize_by.description: The number of instances to be created by this resize request. The group's target size will be increased by this number.
resize_by.rationale: This is just how many instances to add. It's a scaling number, not a security control, so false.

zone.description: The reference of the compute zone scoping this request. If it is not provided, the provider zone is used.
zone.rationale: Determines the region/zone where the resource is created. Policy should restrict it to an approved-region whitelist for data residency; the allowed set is parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable).

requested_run_duration.description: Requested run duration for instances that will be created by this request. At the end of the run duration instance will be deleted.

requested_run_duration.nanos.description: Span of time that's a fraction of a second at nanosecond resolution. Durations less than one second are represented with a 0 seconds field and a positive nanos field. Must be from 0 to 999,999,999 inclusive.
requested_run_duration.nanos.rationale: This is the sub-second part of the run duration. It's a functional timing value, not a security control, so false.

requested_run_duration.seconds.description: Span of time at a resolution of a second. Must be from 600 to 604800 inclusive. Note: minimum and maximum allowed range for requestedRunDuration is 10 minutes (600 seconds) and 7 days(604800 seconds) correspondingly.
requested_run_duration.seconds.rationale: This is how long the created instances run before they're deleted. It's a functional timing value, not a security control, so false.
